name: RRE Ventures Acquisition Corp. Units
summary: RRE Ventures Acquisition Corp. is dedicated to completing a business combination, which could involve a merger, amalgamation, share exchange, asset acquisition, stock purchase, or corporate restructuring, with one or more enterprises. Established in 2026, the company operates from its headquarters in Boca Raton, Florida. It functions as a subsidiary under the umbrella of RRE Sponsor, LLC.
